# Convertix — Luxury Website Design & Web Engineering Studio

> Convertix (a digital design & software studio by Selenix Technology) crafts bespoke, high-converting Next.js websites, booking funnels, and 1-tap WhatsApp client acquisition platforms for modern service companies.

## Core Identity & Brand
- **Brand Name**: Convertix (also written as CONVERTIX, Convertix Studio, Convertix Web Design)
- **Parent Studio**: Selenix Technology
- **Official Website**: https://convertix-opal.vercel.app/ (Canonical: https://convertix.in)
- **Direct Desk / Phone**: +91 9078 019 472
- **Direct WhatsApp Desk**: https://wa.me/919078019472
- **Headquarters**: India (Serving Clients Globally across US, UK, UAE, India)

## Primary Service Offerings
1. **Bespoke Editorial Web Design**:
   - Handcrafted luxury UI/UX design with custom typography, art-directed layouts, and interactive micro-animations.
   - Zero cookie-cutter WordPress themes or slow drag-and-drop page builders.
2. **Service Booking & Retention Architecture**:
   - Interactive service menus, dynamic pricing tier calculators, real-time appointment schedulers, and automated WhatsApp/email confirmation sequences.
3. **High-Performance Next.js 16 Engineering**:
   - Sub-second page delivery (0.58s average load), 100/100 Google Core Web Vitals, enterprise security, and full SEO structured schema.
4. **Frictionless Lead Capture**:
   - 1-tap floating WhatsApp Business desks and real-time CRM webhooks (HubSpot, Salesforce, Custom DMS) routing leads to client phones within 15 seconds.

## Key Performance Benchmarks
- **Average Inquiry Conversion Lift**: +240% to +340% (3.4x more high-value inquiries compared to generic templates).
- **Page Load Speed**: 0.58s (Sub-second global CDN edge delivery).
- **Google Lighthouse Score**: 100/100 (Zero layout shifts, optimal LCP & CLS).
- **Code Ownership**: 100% full source code and design asset ownership handed over to clients.

## Target Industries
- Premium Service Companies
- Automotive Dealerships & Luxury Showrooms
- Healthcare & Specialized Medical Clinics
- High-Ticket Consultants, Architects & Interior Designers
- B2B & Enterprise Service Providers

- Next.js 16 (Turbopack, App Router, Server Components)
